0022600162.text: The Washington Wizards, who are 3-3 overall and 1-2 on the road, visit the Orlando Magic, who are 2-4 overall and 0-3 at home. Washington sits 1st in the Southeast and 6th in the East, while Orlando is 5th in the Southeast, one game back, and 9th in the East. Washington is missing Jamir Watkins (knee, surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Alex Sarr (knee soreness) and Anthony Gill (back spasms) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain). The Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-131 loss in Orlando on March 12, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
